assets.body: Resume Checklist - Data Analyst Structure [ ] One page only. [ ] Contact info + LinkedIn + portfolio link at top. Projects [ ] 2-3 projects with business context, not just tools. [ ] Quantify impact where possible. [ ] Link each project to a GitHub repo or live dashboard. Skills [ ] Only list tools you can defend in an interview. [ ] SQL and one BI tool are non-negotiable.
